queue.title: Duplicates
queue.description: Records that the detection rules consider possible duplicates. Compare them side by side and merge, or mark them as not duplicates.
queue.scanQueued: Duplicate check started. The list updates in a few moments.
queue.dismissed: Pair marked as not a duplicate.
queue.emptyDescription: When the rules find similar records, they show up in this queue.
queue.noTypes: No record type with duplicate detection is available.

settings.title: Detection rules
settings.description: Choose which criteria indicate a possible duplicate. The check runs every day and when a record is created.

merge.title: Merge records
merge.description: Choose, field by field, which value stays. Activities, notes, attachments, tags, deals and links of the merged record move to the primary one, and its history shows up in the primary timeline.
merge.confirmDescription: The merged record goes to the trash and its address opens the primary one. This cannot be undone.
merge.success: Records merged. {{count}} links moved to the primary record.
merge.missing: One of the records was not found or was already merged.
merge.invalid: Choose two different records to merge.
merge.noPermission: You need permission to edit the primary record and delete the duplicate.

warning.title: Possible duplicate
warning.description_one: A similar record already exists: {{names}}. Check Data › Duplicates.
warning.description_other: {{count}} similar records already exist: {{names}}. Check Data › Duplicates.

mergeWith.title: Merge with another record
mergeWith.description: Pick the record that duplicates this one. On the next screen you choose, field by field, which values stay.
mergeWith.label: Duplicate record
